verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim exposes a documented Python API (namespace packages installable via pip) and ROS 2 services/actions for loading worlds, spawning entities, and stepping simulations, which lets AI-native users drive the simulator programmatically. However, probes found no REST/OpenAPI-style public API (404s on openapi.json, swagger.json, llms.txt), so the 'documented public API' is limited to Python/ROS2 SDK-style access rather than a formal web API. Missing for 10: a REST/OpenAPI specification, independent/hands-on confirmation of API usage beyond vendor docs.
